response.sql: SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) as award_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) as share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in manager_award represents one award instance; we count total instances per manager, not distinct award types or awards per year
